maps.objects.acquisition_pedestal.detail: Obtain it at this location after completing the listed plot branches
maps.objects.campfire2.detail: After interacting with the campfire, pick up the ham that falls to the ground.
maps.objects.collapsed_rocks_cave.detail: Break through the collapse and clear the passage.
maps.objects.encounter_wizard_first_cont: Wizard's first appearance
The chamber is vast. Ancient runes cover its walls.

Throw out Grgla's Fish. (Hold it.) Grgla's Fish)
Throw out Toren's potion. (Hold it.) Unknown tincture)
Ask about the guardians.
Ask who is behind this.
Ask what must be done.
Refuse to take part.
[[10,22,"item_grgla_fish"],[35,47,"item_grgla_fish"],[59,73,"item_torren_tincture"],[86,102,"item_torren_tincture"]]
An altar stands at its center. Above it, the wizard hangs motionless in the air.
The runes along the chamber walls flicker, their rhythm breaking. A deep crack echoes through the tower.
The wizard rises higher above the altar, the air tightening around him.
THERE WILL BE NO PARLEY.
Wait! (Only available once)
Stand still. (Only available once.)
Throw Grgla's Fish. (Holding Grgla's Fish)
Throwing out the potion from Torren. (Possessing Unknown Tincture)
Choose “Throw Torren's Tincture.”
You hurl Torren's Tincture at the wizard.
The vial bursts against an invisible barrier, its contents splashing harmlessly across the altar.
His eyes open. Not in surprise... but recognition.
The wizard does not even acknowledge your pathetic attempt.
Choose “Throw Grgla's fish.”
You throw Grgla's fish.
It bounces off an invisible barrier and lands at your feet with a dull slap.
Its dead eyes stare up at you. Somewhere, Grgla would probably be upset.
Choose “WAIT...”
You search the wizard's face for hesitation. There is none.
In his eyes, you are no longer travelers... only a threat already judged.
Choose “Stand your ground.”
The runes on the walls collapse inward, their glow turning sharp and hostile.
Follow up dialogue (Depends on story progress)
Power surges through the tower.
The air fractures as the wizard answers with force.
Images of the four guardians flash through your mind as the wizard searches for them.
"THE FOUR GUARDIANS STILL LIVE."
The wizard slowly descends, acknowledging your presence.
SPEAK.
Ask what happened here. (Only available once.)
Ask the Guardian. (Depending on the progression of the story, this can only be done once.)
Ask who is behind the scenes. (Depending on the progression of the story, this can only be done once.)
Ask what must be done. (Depending on the progression of the story, this can only be done once.)
A sudden pressure grips your mind. You cannot resist it.
Refuse to participate. (Depending on the progression of the story, this can only be done once.)
Draw out weapons. (Only once.)
Choose “Ask what is happening here.”
THE WAY WAS SEALED WITH FOUR KEYS, EACH ENTRUSTED TO A GUARDIAN.
Scarlet runes flicker across the barrier around him.
THE SEALS ARE FAILING.
Choose “Ask about the guardians.”
THE GUARDIANS WERE SHAPED TO WATCH WHAT MUST NOT WAKE.
BUT THE SEALS HAVE BEEN BREACHED.
His presence presses harder against your thoughts.
The wizard searches your memories. He sees the guardian fall, and he knows you killed it.
HE HAS FOUND THE WOUND.
Choose “Ask who is behind this.”
ONCE, HE STOOD BESIDE ME.
HE KNOWS THIS TOWER. HE KNOWS WHAT LIES BELOW.
NOW HE SEEKS TO OPEN THE GATE.
HE WILL NOT TURN BACK.
Choose “Ask what must be done.”
THERE IS STILL TIME.
BARELY.
His presence reaches through the tower.
The voice comes without sound, spoken directly into your mind.
HE WAITS BELOW.
DESCEND. STOP HIM.
I WILL FOLLOW.
Choose “Refuse to take part.”
The runes flare, their judgment complete.
THEN YOU ARE AN OBSTACLE.
OBSTACLES ARE REMOVED.
Choose “Draw your weapons.”
SO BE IT.
A violent pulse of magic surges from the altar.
THIS TOWER WAS BUILT OVER A GATE THAT MUST NEVER OPEN.
With those words, the wizard unravels, his form dissolving into nothing.
A deep vibration runs through the tower.
It has begun. Time to settle this.
FOUR GUARDIANS WERE ENTRUSTED WITH THE KEYS.
YOU HAVE KILLED A GUARDIAN.
maps.objects.fast_travel_portal.detail-2: Unlocks a station after interaction. Held Teleportation Stone You can choose the unlocked station.
maps.objects.grave2_crumble.detail: The gravestone crumbles under the weight of time.
maps.objects.pit_cave2_outfall.detail: The ceiling opening in the checkpoint.

maps.puzzles.abandoned_mines_cave.1.goal: Open the secret wall on the south side.
maps.puzzles.abandoned_mines_cave.1.step: Press the hidden button on the wall at (20, -24), then walk into the passage opened at (16, -21) and (17, -21).
maps.puzzles.abandoned_mines_cave.1.titl: Hidden button on the rock wall of the abandoned cave
maps.puzzles.abandoned_mines_cave.2.goal: Open the double-grid secret wall on the west side.
maps.puzzles.abandoned_mines_cave.2.step: Press the pressure plate at (26, -32), then walk west to (23, -32) and (24, -32).
maps.puzzles.abandoned_mines_cave.2.titl: Secret sensor board of the cave
maps.puzzles.caerlin_west_dungeon.1.goal: Push the four stone statues to the pattern grid to open the north-side gate.
maps.puzzles.caerlin_west_dungeon.1.step: Starting from the initial position, push the upper-left stone statue 1 grid south, the lower-left one 1 grid east, the upper-right one 1 grid west, and the lower-right one 1 grid north and then west.
The four targets are (15, -43), (13, -42), (15, -41), and (14, -40). Before pushing each target, make sure to move to the other side of the stone statue.
First, plan a safe retreat route. Push the four statues onto the tree pattern in stages. When crowded, you can pull the reset lever at (15, -44), or push one statue out of the formation for reset.
maps.puzzles.caerlin_west_dungeon.1.titl: The four stone statues of the gravewood crypt
maps.puzzles.caerlin_woods.1.goal: Securely obtain stable mutations and 100 XP.
maps.puzzles.caerlin_woods.1.step-1: Put 10 {item} into the golden cup, then drink from the glowing cup.
maps.puzzles.caerlin_woods.1.step-2: Drinking from the golden cup or drinking without putting the gold coins first will result in unstable mutations and awaken hostile tree spirits.
maps.puzzles.caerlin_woods.1.title: The double cups of the forest altar
maps.puzzles.dragon_den.1.goal: Follow the order of the runes to open the east gate.
maps.puzzles.dragon_den.1.step-1: Step on the flames at (-28, -65), the crown at (-27, -64), the eyes at (-27, -65), the tree at (-27, -66), and the snake at (-26, -65), in order.
maps.puzzles.dragon_den.1.step-2: If the order is incorrect, you can pull the lever at (-26, -67) to reset.
maps.puzzles.dragon_den.1.title: Five rune pressure plates
maps.puzzles.dragon_den.2.goal: Dispel the teleportation loop and proceed to the next area.
maps.puzzles.dragon_den.2.step-1: The corridor will send the group back to its original position. Find the secret button on the wall at (-11, -54), and press it to cross the newly exposed passage.
maps.puzzles.dragon_den.2.title: Loop through the corridor
maps.puzzles.dragon_den.3.goal: Open the library hidden behind the stone wall.
maps.puzzles.dragon_den.3.step-1: Find the hidden button on the south wall at (2, -58). You can enter after opening the two secret walls.
maps.puzzles.dragon_den.3.title: Dragon's Cave Secret Library
maps.puzzles.east_garden.1.goal: Obtain the {item} from the northwest pedestal in the East Garden.
maps.puzzles.east_garden.1.step-2: After placing the three offerings in place, go to the base at (3, -6) to retrieve the sphere.
maps.puzzles.east_garden.1.title: Three kinds of offerings in Dongyuan Garden
maps.puzzles.east_garden.2.goal: Obtain the {item} from the northeast pedestal in the East Garden.
maps.puzzles.east_garden.2.step-1: If you walk near (13, -4), the door will be closed, and there are five enemies waking up in the area.
maps.puzzles.east_garden.2.step-2: After defeating them all, pick up the ball at the base at (13, -6).
maps.puzzles.east_garden.2.title: Test of Courage
maps.puzzles.east_garden.3.goal: Obtain the {item} from the southwest pedestal in the East Garden.
maps.puzzles.east_garden.3.step-1: Go to the pedestal next to the three fountains (3, 6), deal with nearby enemies, and then pick up the ball.
maps.puzzles.east_garden.3.title: The blue key sphere is next to the three fountains
maps.puzzles.east_garden.4.goal: Obtain the {item} from the southeast pedestal in the East Garden.
maps.puzzles.east_garden.4.step-1: Walk to (22, 9) to trigger the Frog King. Directly refusing his mental contact will lead to a battle. After defeating the Frog King, you can pick up the ball from the pedestal at (24, 10).
maps.puzzles.east_garden.4.step-2: If you have accepted Roots of Rebellion, make mental contact, offer blood at the fountain and help the mycelium fight back.
maps.puzzles.east_garden.4.title: Frog King and Swamp Base
maps.puzzles.forgotten_vein.1.goal: Press both pressure plates at the same time and open the west side door.
maps.puzzles.forgotten_vein.1.step-1: First, push the two stone statues to each other, leaving space for the team to walk around the side of the statues.
maps.puzzles.forgotten_vein.1.step-2: Push the stone statues to (6, -63) and (8, -63) respectively. When stuck, pull the lever at (7, -62) to reset it.
maps.puzzles.forgotten_vein.1.title: Two stone spirits of the Blightvein Mine
maps.puzzles.forgotten_vein.2.goal: Clear the hidden passage after activating the torches.
maps.puzzles.forgotten_vein.2.step-1: Operate the torch on the wall at (8, -54) to open two secret walls to the north.
maps.puzzles.forgotten_vein.2.title: The torch secret door of the mineral vein
maps.puzzles.mausoleum.1.goal: Enter the interior of the mausoleum via the side path.
maps.puzzles.mausoleum.1.step-1: Walk further along the side path, and use the torch on the wall at (6, 1) to open two more secret walls along the same line.
maps.puzzles.mausoleum.1.title: The torch hidden door at the side entrance
maps.puzzles.mausoleum.2.goal: Open two hidden passages leading down to the lower floors.
maps.puzzles.mausoleum.2.step-1: First, pull the lever at (10, 1) to open the first section, then pull the lever at (13, 1) to open the next section.
maps.puzzles.mausoleum.2.title: The two hidden walls of the tomb
maps.puzzles.mausoleum_2.1.goal: Find the fake torch and open the secret wall.
maps.puzzles.mausoleum_2.1.step-1: Extinguish the blue fire basin at (-4, -2). Wrongly extinguishing two other fire basins may summon the Faded.
maps.puzzles.mausoleum_2.1.step-2: After the blue fire is extinguished, the secret wall at (-6, -1) will open.
maps.puzzles.mausoleum_2.1.title: Determine the authenticity of the three-color flame
maps.puzzles.mausoleum_2.2.goal: Walk to the North Gate at (11, -14), leaving the gate open.
maps.puzzles.mausoleum_2.2.step-1: Start from (7, -10) along the map route. Follow the sequence: North 1, East 2, South 1, East 1, South 3, East 2, North 2, East 2, North 2, West 3, North 3.
maps.puzzles.mausoleum_2.2.step-2: Stepping into the grid with the burning basin will close the north gate. If you step into the wrong place, return to the entrance and try again.
maps.puzzles.mausoleum_2.2.title: Avoid the corridor with the burning basins
maps.puzzles.mausoleum_2.3.goal: Remove the invincibility status of the leader.
maps.puzzles.mausoleum_2.3.step-1: Extinguish all the green burning basins in the four corners of the room: (9, 2), (15, 2), (9, 6), (15, 6).
maps.puzzles.mausoleum_2.3.step-2: First, break up the obstacles in the way, then approach the burning basins. After extinguishing the fourth one, you can damage Talirik.
maps.puzzles.mausoleum_2.3.title: Talirik's four green burning basins
maps.puzzles.mausoleum_3_2.1.goal: Use five sets of burning basins to open the south gate. You can also find the secret room on the east side.
maps.puzzles.mausoleum_3_2.1.step-1: Arrange each set of burning basins as the numbers one to five on a dice. To open the south gate, ignite the first set (-2, -16) and the four sets on the west side arranged in a square. Extinguish the remaining burning basins.
maps.puzzles.mausoleum_3_2.1.step-2: To open the secret room on the east side, only ignite the second set (two sets arranged diagonally on the north side) and the fifth set (the four corners and the center on the southeast side).
maps.puzzles.mausoleum_3_2.1.title: Dice-shaped burning basins
maps.puzzles.mausoleum_3_2.2.goal: Open the path leading to the hidden base.
maps.puzzles.mausoleum_3_2.2.step-1: Press the hidden button at (4, 2), and walk east into the hidden walls at (6, 2) and (7, 2).
maps.puzzles.mausoleum_3_2.2.title: The wall button of the Chambers of Endless Sleep
maps.puzzles.mines_under_forest.1.goal: Press the sensor panel on the far side, and open the southern passage.
maps.puzzles.mines_under_forest.1.step-1: Facing the pit on the other side, throw a small stone or debris from your backpack towards the point at (28, -28), so that it lands on the pressure plate at that location.
maps.puzzles.mines_under_forest.1.step-2: The pressure plate only senses objects. Walk past the opened door, allowing the object to remain on the plate.
maps.puzzles.mines_under_forest.1.title: Throw objects through the pit
maps.puzzles.mines_under_forest.2.goal: Switch to the lid of the pit, and open the secret wall next to it.
maps.puzzles.mines_under_forest.2.step-1: Place objects on the pressure plates at (27, -20) or (25, -19), switching to the corresponding pits.
maps.puzzles.mines_under_forest.2.step-2: There is another hidden pressure plate on the west side at (25, -20). Step on it to open the secret wall to the northwest at (24, -22).
maps.puzzles.mines_under_forest.2.title: The cover of the pit
maps.puzzles.mines_under_forest.3.goal: Open the hidden alcove in the Hollowgrave Tunnels.
maps.puzzles.mines_under_forest.3.step-1: Press the secret button at (10, -40), and the hidden walls at (11, -40) and (12, -40) will open.
maps.puzzles.mines_under_forest.3.title: Hidden buttons on the mining walls
maps.puzzles.starting_forest.1.goal: Open the north gate from the inside of the forest.
maps.puzzles.starting_forest.1.step-1: Press the small button on the stone wall at (-2, -26) to open the gate at (-3, -28).
maps.puzzles.starting_forest.1.title: The button on the stone wall for opening the door
maps.puzzles.surroundings_cave.1.goal: Arrange two patterns to open the main door and the secret compartment on the west side.
maps.puzzles.surroundings_cave.1.step-1: The buttons in the north row control each column, and the buttons on the west side control each row. Observe the position of the light after pressing each button.
maps.puzzles.surroundings_cave.1.step-2: Arrange a X shape at the main door, lighting the four corners and the center.
maps.puzzles.surroundings_cave.1.step-3: The secret chamber should be arranged in a T shape, illuminating the entire north column, the center of the north column, and the center of the south column. There are Frostbite Edge and Emerald in the boxes on the west side.
maps.puzzles.surroundings_cave.1.title: Nine-square pattern
maps.puzzles.surroundings_cave.2.goal: Enter the secret room where the Ancient Book: The Last Guardian is stored.
maps.puzzles.surroundings_cave.2.step-1: Find the hidden button with the label (-12, -1) among the vines on the southwest side of the damaged obelisk. Press the button, and proceed through the new path that appears on the northwest side.
maps.puzzles.surroundings_cave.2.title: The hidden button is next to the obelisk
maps.puzzles.swamp.1.goal: Find the way out of the Grimfen maze in the fog.
maps.puzzles.swamp.1.step-1: Step into (41, 33) and find that the maze is blocked. Then return to (32, 33) to talk about the maze with Grgla, and invite him to be a guide.
maps.puzzles.swamp.1.step-2: Enter the foggy area from (41, 33). Follow his instructions at the fork in the road, and reach the exit at (52, 40).
maps.puzzles.swamp.2.goal: Open the gate on the south side of Grimfen.
maps.puzzles.swamp.2.step-1: Press the dark button on the wall at (44, 40), and you can pass through the gate at (43, 41).
maps.puzzles.swamp.2.title: Hidden gate outside the fog
maps.puzzles.swamp_dungeon1.1.goal: After drinking from four fountains, obtain Whispering Armor and 120 XP.
maps.puzzles.swamp_dungeon1.1.step-1: Each of the four fountains selects a team member to drink from them once. Who will undergo permanent changes is determined by the mutant fountains. The Raven who drinks from the fountains will receive stable mutations.
maps.puzzles.swamp_dungeon1.1.step-2: The other three will cause poisoning, mucus corrosion, or freezing, adding 100 points of ice damage. First, replenish the team's health, then have the team members who can withstand the effects drink it.
maps.puzzles.swamp_dungeon1.1.step-3: After drinking everything, pick up the Whispering Armor at the base located at (5, -17).
maps.puzzles.swamp_dungeon1.1.title: Four pink fountains
maps.puzzles.swamp_dungeon1.2.goal: Open the inner gate of The Mireheart.
maps.puzzles.swamp_dungeon1.2.step-1: Press the two skull buttons next to the gate. On the map, they share the same position at (-15, -2).
maps.puzzles.swamp_dungeon1.2.title: Press the double skull button
maps.puzzles.swamp_dungeon1.3.goal: Open the hidden passage that allows access to the second tower's rune.
maps.puzzles.swamp_dungeon1.3.step-1: Unlock the flag hanging near (-14, 13), press the metal button behind it, then enter through the hidden entrance on the side.
maps.puzzles.swamp_dungeon1.3.title: The rune secret room after unlocking the flag
maps.puzzles.swamp_dungeon2.1.goal: Open the eastern gate to obtain the fourth Tentacle Root, then open the southern secret room.
maps.puzzles.swamp_dungeon2.1.step-1: From the initial state (only the first gate is open), press southwest (-6, -4) and northeast (-5, -6). All four gates will open. Process the Tentacle Root at the eastern end (0, -5).
maps.puzzles.swamp_dungeon2.1.step-2: Return to the button area, then press the two buttons on the north side (-6, -6) and (-5, -6). This will close all the gates and open the southern secret room.
maps.puzzles.swamp_dungeon2.1.step-3: If you only want to open the secret room from the initial state, simply press the two buttons on the west side (-6, -6) and (-6, -4).
maps.puzzles.swamp_dungeon2.1.title: The four skull buttons and the gates
maps.puzzles.swamp_dungeon2.2.goal: Use the chain gates to move through the cell area.
maps.puzzles.swamp_dungeon2.2.step-1: Opening the chain gate at (-14, -10) will also open the side gates. Spiders from both sides will come out together.
maps.puzzles.swamp_dungeon2.2.title: Linked spider cages
maps.puzzles.swamp_lost_city.1.goal: Enter the secret chamber where heavy crossbows are stored.
maps.puzzles.swamp_lost_city.1.step-1: Press the dark button on the east wall at (2, -17). The two cells on the west side will open.
maps.puzzles.swamp_lost_city.1.title: Press the moss-covered dark button
maps.puzzles.tower_level1.1.goal: Step on each pressure plate to open the north gate leading to the Shadow Trials.
maps.puzzles.tower_level1.1.step-1: Start from the south at (-2, -6). The light-colored dots on the map represent the starting cells.
maps.puzzles.tower_level1.1.step-2: Move in the order: North 2, East 1, North 1, West 2, South 3, West 2, North 2, East 1, North 1, West 1, North 2, East 1, South 1, East 3, North 1. Reach (-1, -11).
maps.puzzles.tower_level1.1.step-3: If you press the button incorrectly, return to the south side and press the button at (-1, -6) to reset.
maps.puzzles.tower_level1.1.title: Draw a line on the west side
maps.puzzles.tower_level1.2.goal: Guide light into the stone chamber to remove the invincibility status of the Shadow Beast and open the east-side passage.
maps.puzzles.tower_level1.2.step-1: After entering the room, the door will close. Pull out the three curtains on the north wall at positions (1, -15), (3, -15), and (5, -15).
maps.puzzles.tower_level1.2.step-2: After the third curtain is pulled open, the light allows Shadow Beast to be injured. If the east gate remains closed, knocking down the Shadow Beast will open the gate.
maps.puzzles.tower_level1.2.title: Shadow Trial
maps.puzzles.tower_level1.3.goal: Step on each pressure plate once to open the southern fence gate and the gate leading to the second floor.
maps.puzzles.tower_level1.3.step-1: Start from the north side at (8, -11). The light-colored dots on the map represent the starting positions.
maps.puzzles.tower_level1.3.step-2: Move in the order: West 1, South 1, East 2, North 1, East 2, South 5, West 2, North 2, East 1, North 1, West 3, South 1, East 1, South 1, West 1, South 1. Reach (7, -6).
maps.puzzles.tower_level1.3.step-3: If you step on the wrong button, you can return to the north side and reset by pressing the button at (8, -13).
maps.puzzles.tower_level1.3.title: Draw a line on the east side
maps.puzzles.tower_level2.1.goal: Open the door from the normal floors to the eastern statue room.
maps.puzzles.tower_level2.1.step-1: Pass through the double-fire basin fence gate on the west side of the decayed floor, and then use the stone coffin inside to enter this room.
maps.puzzles.tower_level2.1.step-2: Press the buttons at the northernmost and southernmost positions on the wall: (1, -4) and (1, -2). Leave the middle buttons unchanged.
maps.puzzles.tower_level2.1.step-3: Return to the original room via the stone coffin, then proceed through the newly opened east-side passage.
maps.puzzles.tower_level2.1.title: There are three wall buttons
maps.puzzles.tower_level2.2.goal: Arrange the three knight statues properly, and open the fence door leading to the third floor.
maps.puzzles.tower_level2.2.step-1: Use the stone coffin from the east side to the decayed floor, and check the arrangement of the statues on that side.
maps.puzzles.tower_level2.2.step-2: Return to the normal floor, and push the three knight statues to positions (5, -3), (6, -3), and (7, -3). You can adjust the positions by using the reset button inside the room.
maps.puzzles.tower_level2.2.title: Mirror the knight statues
maps.puzzles.tower_level2_corrupted.1.go: Open the west-side fence door and find the stone coffin leading to the room with the three buttons.
maps.puzzles.tower_level2_corrupted.1.st: Light the fire pans on either side of the fence door at (-1, -8) and (1, -8).
Pass through the fence door and use the stone coffin inside to return to the wall button room on the normal floor.
maps.puzzles.tower_level2_corrupted.1.ti: Use the double fire pans on the decayed floor
maps.puzzles.tower_level2_corrupted.2.go: Check the target locations of the three statues on the normal floor.
maps.puzzles.tower_level2_corrupted.2.st: Note down the arrangement here: the three target positions are (5, -3), (6, -3), and (7, -3).
Use the eastern stone coffin to return to the normal floor, and then arrange the three knights in the same order.
maps.puzzles.tower_level2_corrupted.2.ti: The mirror-like clues of the knight statues…
maps.puzzles.tower_level3.1.goal: Arrange the four statues according to the drawing, and open the passage behind the northern painting.
maps.puzzles.tower_level3.1.step-1: Push the wizard to the outermost positions at (1, -11) and (5, -11), and push the knights to the inner positions at (2, -11) and (4, -11).
maps.puzzles.tower_level3.1.step-2: After arranging the four statues along the northern side, the passage behind the central painting will be opened. The buttons on either side of the hall columns can be used to reset the statues.
maps.puzzles.tower_level3.1.title: The gallery statues…
maps.puzzles.tower_level3.2.goal: Open the north-side dark wall leading to the fourth floor.
maps.puzzles.tower_level3.2.step-1: After entering the small room, use the mechanism at the door to close the southern entrance, thereby darkening the room.
maps.puzzles.tower_level3.2.step-2: Touch the button hidden on the western wall in the darkness (3, -15), and the dark wall on the north side will open.
maps.puzzles.tower_level3.2.title: Button in the dark room
maps.puzzles.tower_level3.3.goal: Find the swamp memories of the Archmage.
maps.puzzles.tower_level3.3.step-1: Press the dark button at (5, -7) to open the two dark walls at (6, -5) and (7, -5).
maps.puzzles.tower_level3.3.step-2: Walk into the hall at (8, -5), triggering the memories of the swamp monster.
maps.puzzles.tower_level3.3.title: The swamp room hidden behind the gallery
maps.puzzles.tower_level4.1.goal: Use eight rune buttons to open the north-side main door and the west-side treasure room.
maps.puzzles.tower_level4.1.step-1: Enter the blue transfer point from the hallway and complete four rune rooms in order.
maps.puzzles.tower_level4.1.step-2: The north-side main door can only be opened for A Blue, B Yellow, C Yellow, and D Blue; all other buttons remain closed.
maps.puzzles.tower_level4.1.step-3: The west-side treasure room can only be opened for C Blue; all other seven buttons are closed.
maps.puzzles.tower_level4.1.title: Dual-color rune teleport ring
maps.puzzles.tower_level4.2.goal: Pass through the fake wall and climb to the fifth floor.
maps.puzzles.tower_level4.2.step-1: At the end, facing away from the north side of the wall that blocks the way, press the backspace key to move north into the wall.
maps.puzzles.tower_level4.2.title: Stairs that go in the opposite direction
maps.puzzles.underkeep_cemetery.1.goal: Awaken the monument in the courtyard and obtain the password to the mausoleum entrance.
maps.puzzles.underkeep_cemetery.1.step-5: After placing all four offerings, write "The Blood of the Watcher Still Nourishes the Roots" and use it at the main entrance of the tomb.
maps.puzzles.underkeep_cemetery.1.title: Offering for the four tombstones
maps.puzzles.underkeep_cemetery.2.goal: Guards at the entrance to the mausoleum, passed through by a secret staircase.
maps.puzzles.underkeep_cemetery.2.step-1: Look for the staircase covered by roots on the southeast side of the courtyard (20, 14), descend to the mausoleum and continue along the path.
maps.puzzles.underkeep_cemetery.2.step-2: At the end of the corridor, operate the torches that are already on the wall to open the hidden wall.
maps.puzzles.underkeep_cemetery.2.title: Side entrance to the mausoleum
maps.puzzles.underkeep_surroundings.1.go: Solve the tombstone riddle and obtain Feather of Mercy.
maps.puzzles.underkeep_surroundings.1.st: Place the {item} on the grave at (29, -31) to turn it into a {item}.
maps.puzzles.underkeep_surroundings.1.ti: The white feather of the unnamed tomb
maps.puzzles.underkeep_surroundings.2.go: Open the main entrance to the tower.
maps.puzzles.underkeep_surroundings.2.st: Buy the {item} from Torren outside the tower after meeting him in the village and reading the underground obelisk.
Return to the tower gate and insert the four segments into their individual slots.
maps.puzzles.underkeep_surroundings.2.ti: The four runes on the tower
maps.puzzles.undertower.1.goal: Trigger Torren to enter the Demon Transfer Gate, resulting in the ending of the game.
maps.puzzles.undertower.1.step-1: Down to the bottom of the tower with the Soulcleaver, and fight Torren.
maps.puzzles.undertower.1.step-2: Line up Torren with the Demon Transfer Gate located at (-1, -12), and use the Soulcleaver's repelling skill to push Torren into the gate.
maps.puzzles.undertower.1.title: Push Torren into the transfer gate
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_1.1.goal: Adjust the two rows of fire basins, and open the secret chamber on the west side.
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_1.1.step-1: Leave only the red and blue flames in the north row: (-32, -74), (-31, -74).
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_1.1.step-2: Leave only the green and red flames in the south row: (-33, -70), (-31, -70). Extinguish the remaining four fire basins.
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_1.1.title: Adjust the eight fire basins with the purple and yellow markings
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_1.2.goal: Open the south-side secret room and find the Garden Key.
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_1.2.step-1: Activate the southwest green fire (-21, -59), northeast red fire (-17, -63), northwest ordinary fire (-21, -63), and southeast blue fire (-17, -59) according to the season.
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_1.2.step-2: Incorrect sequence will cause the fire basin to extinguish and cause damage. Successfully retrieve the garden key from the south side of the dark wall.
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_1.2.title: Four-season fire basin
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_1.3.goal: Avoid the invisible pressure plates that send the team back to the entrance.
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_1.3.step-1: Pass through four obstacles from north to south. The safe areas are in the west, center, east, and center in order.
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_1.3.step-2: If you step on the wrong side, you will return to the entrance. You can proceed in the same order.
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_1.3.title: Blind corridor
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_1.4.goal: Transport the chest from the cell to the corridor.
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_1.4.step-1: Press the button on the west side in the middle row to move the chest to the northeast cell.
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_1.4.step-2: Press the button on the northeast side again to move the box into the corridor from that cell.
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_1.4.title: The relocation chest in the sixth cell
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_1.5.goal: Use the enemies to trigger four sensors, and open the west-side door.
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_1.5.step-1: Press the button at (-18, -54) to summon bone enemies.
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_1.5.step-2: Let them pass through the four sensors at (-18, -53), (-16, -53), (-18, -51), and (-16, -51). Stepping on these sensors will not trigger anything.
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_1.5.title: Use bone pressure to crush stones
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_1.6.goal: Open the sealed door leading to The Silent Riddles.
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_1.6.step-1: Collect the {item} from each of the eight pedestals, four per garden. Hand in all eight at the outer hall door (-3, -73).
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_2.1.goal: Present the four daily items to open the hidden wall.
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_2.1.lower-east: southern niche on the east wall
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_2.1.step-1: First, pull the lever at (-20, -73) to enter the room.
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_2.1.title: Four mysterious wall niches
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_2.1.upper-east: northern niche on the east wall
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_2.2.goal: Light two torches at the position 2:35 to obtain the iron key.
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_2.2.step-1: Light the northeast torch at 2 o’clock (-3, -75) and the southwest torch at 7 o’clock (-6, -72). Leave the other ten unlit.
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_2.2.step-2: Grab the iron key at the base in (-5, -74).
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_2.2.title: The clock of twelve torches
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_2.3.goal: Open the north side gate using a projectile.
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_2.3.step-1: In the west-facing part of the corridor, throw small stones and other projectiles towards the west wall, making sure they land on the pressure plate at the western end (-22, -84).
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_2.3.step-2: After opening the north gate (-22, -86), continue along the north side corridor to the wall niche at (-22, -82) to obtain the iron key.
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_2.3.title: Test of Dexterity
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_2.4.goal: Cross the pit that switches between openings and open the next gate.
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_2.4.step-1: When the skeleton moves to the east, it will step on different boards, causing the pits on the west to open in turn.
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_2.4.step-2: Use ranged attacks to destroy the skeleton in the pits, then move through the covered boards. If you fall, return to the lower transfer point.
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_2.4.title: Open the pits in turn
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_2.5.goal: Open the three secret walls in the side rooms.
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_2.5.step-1: Press the button hidden among the moss three times at (-15, -73), (-14, -70), and (-16, -69), then enter the exposed side rooms.
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_2.5.title: Three moss-covered buttons
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_2.6.goal: Switch from a safe position to two access points leading to the furnace.
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_2.6.step-1: Pull (-20, -66) to open the gate, then throw the item behind the gate at (-19, -64) onto the pressure plate, switching between the two pits on the side.
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_2.6.step-2: There is an Iron Key inside the chest located at (-21, -64).
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_2.6.title: Pull-back dual pit sensor
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_3.1.goal: Block the passage before the giant hits the team.
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_3.1.step-1: Stepping into the corridor will attract the giant. Press the wall button to close the door when approaching (-13, -70), then continue to leave the assault route.
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_3.1.title: Underground giants during the assault
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_3.2.goal: Use the incinerator to eliminate the giants and open the path to the Forge of Creation.
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_3.2.step-1: Lead the pursuing giants into the center of the fire pit. After the team exits, close all four gateways from the outside.
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_3.2.step-2: At (-3, -62), pull the lever. If one gate is left open, the safety lock will jam the lever. As long as the giants remain outside the furnace, activating it will not cause any damage.
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_3.2.step-3: After the giants disappear, follow their original path towards the Forge of Creation.
maps.puzzles.west_dungeon_3.2.title: Giants in the incinerator
maps.puzzles.west_garden.1.goal: Obtain the {item} from the northwest pedestal in the West Garden.
maps.puzzles.west_garden.1.step-1: The five target tiles form a row from (1, -4) to (5, -4). Push each statue south from the north side onto its tile. If a tree blocks the way, first make room from the side.
maps.puzzles.west_garden.1.step-2: Push the stone statues to the outside of the two ends of the row to reset them. After arranging them, pick up the ball from the base at (3, -8).
maps.puzzles.west_garden.1.title: The five stone statue ghosts are in line
maps.puzzles.west_garden.2.goal: Obtain the {item} from the northeast pedestal in the West Garden.
maps.puzzles.west_garden.2.step-1: Find the fountain among the shrubs at (13, -6), and knock it down with a ranged attack from the outside.
maps.puzzles.west_garden.2.step-2: After the shrubs disappear, take the ball from the same base.
maps.puzzles.west_garden.2.title: Fountain in the bushes
maps.puzzles.west_garden.3.counterweight: Throw one heavy item onto the pressure plate at {coordinates}.
maps.puzzles.west_garden.3.goal: Obtain the {item} from the southwest pedestal in the West Garden.
maps.puzzles.west_garden.3.step-1: Throw weights from safe ground. The nearby wall niches contain a {item}, {item}, and {item} you can use.
maps.puzzles.west_garden.3.step-2: After pressing down all five pieces, walk to the base at (1, 6) to retrieve the ball.
maps.puzzles.west_garden.3.title: Place the counterweight pieces at the fifth pit
maps.puzzles.west_garden.4.goal: Obtain the {item} from the southeast pedestal in the West Garden.
maps.puzzles.west_garden.4.step-1: Using the arrangement in the East Garden as a reference, move the seven stone statues to (11, 4), (13, 4), (15, 4), (13, 6), (11, 8), (13, 8), and (15, 8).
maps.puzzles.west_garden.4.step-2: The red reset button will return the stone statues to their original positions. After completion, collect the sphere at the base of (15, 6).
maps.puzzles.west_garden.4.title: Mirror the seven stone statues
maps.puzzles.west_woods.1.goal: Push the five stone statues onto the cross-shaped pressure plate to open the northern gate.
maps.puzzles.west_woods.1.step-1: Push the five stone statues to (11, -24), (8, -22), (11, -22), (14, -22), and (11, -20) respectively.
maps.puzzles.west_woods.1.step-2: If you push them incorrectly, you can use the lever by the field to restore the stone statues to their original positions.
maps.puzzles.west_woods.1.title: Create a cross-shaped formation of stone statues
maps.puzzles.west_woods.2.goal: Have the guards return to the white birch forest to retrieve the lantern key.
maps.puzzles.west_woods.2.step-1: First, check the lantern at the white birch forest (24, -28). Keep the lantern and follow the clues.
maps.puzzles.west_woods.2.step-2: At (31, -16) The charred nameless tomb can be summoned using the Spirit Lantern, Voidshard, or Voidcaller.
maps.puzzles.west_woods.2.step-3: Stay alive and follow to the birch forest (26, -28). Break the hanging torches in the subsequent events to obtain the key.
maps.puzzles.west_woods.2.title: Guide the Soul Warden
